newsitem.title: CHINA: China province to open new port to foreign ships.
newsitem.headline: China province to open new port to foreign ships.

text.p: China is to open a new port in Penglai city in the eastern province of Shandong to foreign merchant ships, the China News Service said on Wednesday.
The Penglai port had berths for 3,000-tonne, 5,000-tonne and 10,000-tonne ships and had a handling capacity of nearly one million tonnes a year, the agency said.
The port, which opened in late 1995, had been built with an investment of 80 million yuan ($9.6 million), Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
